description: Merges error groups that are the same bug into one: their events move to the target group (targetId) and new events with their fingerprints join it too. With groupByMessagePrefix, new events of the target's type whose message starts with that text also join it, for messages that differ only by an ID or a number. Returns what was merged.

errorIds.description: Error groups to merge into the target (same project)

groupByMessagePrefix.description: Optional message prefix: new events of the target's type whose message starts with it are grouped into the target

name: runheed_merge_errors
title: Merge duplicate errors
